# Nexora PDF Office

> Nexora PDF Office is an Android document and PDF app with free PDF tools available directly on this website.

## Website tools

- Read a PDF in the browser.
- Merge multiple PDF files into one.
- Reorder and rotate PDF pages, then download the updated file.
- Convert PDF pages to PNG or JPEG images and download them as a ZIP file.
- Create a PDF from PNG and JPEG images.
- Website PDF files are processed locally in the browser and are not uploaded to this site's server.
- Dedicated, indexable feature guides:
  - Smart document scanner: https://pdf.nexorastudio-eg.com/articles/smart-document-scanner.html
  - PDF password protection: https://pdf.nexorastudio-eg.com/articles/protect-pdf-with-password.html
  - PDF compression: https://pdf.nexorastudio-eg.com/articles/compress-pdf-files.html
  - PDF and image conversion: https://pdf.nexorastudio-eg.com/articles/pdf-image-conversion.html
  - PDF signatures and stamps: https://pdf.nexorastudio-eg.com/articles/pdf-signatures-and-stamps.html
- The scanner guide covers Google ML Kit document scanning, page-edge detection, perspective correction, and multi-page capture.
- The conversion guide illustrates image-to-PDF and text-to-PDF with screenshots/screen-06.webp and screenshots/screen-08.webp. Website tools export PDF pages to PNG/JPEG locally in the browser.
- The signatures guide explains that a visible signature or stamp is not necessarily a certificate-backed digital signature.
- Search crawlers can discover pages from https://pdf.nexorastudio-eg.com/sitemap.xml; robots.txt allows crawling.

## Android app

- The Android app includes document scanning and file protection features.
- Its scanner uses Google ML Kit Document Scanner API for document capture and page processing.
- File protection uses PDFBox-Android to create password-protected PDF copies. Encryption algorithms and supported permissions depend on the app's implementation and PDF reader compatibility.
- PDF compression is available in the Android app. Compression results vary with document content and settings; no fixed size reduction is guaranteed.
- The Android app includes image-to-PDF and text-to-PDF conversion. Website tools create PDFs from PNG/JPEG images and export PDF pages as PNG/JPEG locally in the browser.
- The Android app includes signature and stamp tools for PDF documents; a visible mark alone does not establish signer identity or document integrity.
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nexora.office

## Languages

- The website supports Arabic and English.
